title: Admin panel menus and pages
summary: The Admin panel menu is regrouped into clear sections with breadcrumbs and sub-menus. System status, Roles and Help desk topics are easier to scan and edit.

added: Admin pages show breadcrumbs and a section sub-menu when a section has more than one page.
System status opens with summary tiles for checks, version, backup and the queue.
Roles lists each role with a side panel of permissions grouped by module.
changed: The Admin panel menu is split into Dashboard, Users and access, System, Modules, Apps and content, Operations and Help desk, with a short description on each link.
Help desk topics use a topic list and one edit form with a single Save, including an unsaved-changes notice.
Admin tables and status badges use the same shared patterns across audit, modules, 2FA and push delivery.
accessibility: Admin breadcrumbs use a labelled landmark; section sub-menus mark the current page with aria-current.

internal_notes: Epic #413. Leaves #432–#437. Deploy via gh workflow run deploy-cloudron.yml -f tag=v0.6.16.
